profile.name: TEMPer USB温度传感器
profile.description: 一种通过 USB 连接的温度传感器设备，用于实验中采集环境温度或样品附近温度。根据型号不同，可支持 1 到 2 个传感器通道，部分型号还可读取湿度数据，并可应用校准比例与偏移。
profile.description_en: A USB-connected temperature sensing device used in laboratory setups to measure ambient temperature or temperature near a sample. Depending on the model, it may support 1 to 2 sensor channels, and some variants can also report humidity and apply calibration scale and offset.
